title: Homeowner shares identified registration data
description: Account registration requires the homeowner to provide identified personal data such as name or email to the Home Hub.

title: Home Hub processes identified account data
description: The Home Hub receives and processes identified data during account registration and camera/sensor enrollment.

title: Unique identifiers in registration flow
description: The data flow may include unique identifiers such as device serial numbers or account IDs that enable linking.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not specify exact data fields, so linking potential is inferred from typical registration.

title: Account registration creates attributable evidence
description: Registering an account and enrolling devices creates data records that can be attributed to the homeowner, preventing denial of actions.

title: Potentially sensitive device enrollment data
description: Enrolling cameras/sensors may disclose sensitive data types related to home security setup beyond minimal requirements.
uncertainty_note: Depends on exact data collected, not detailed in flow description.

title: Potential unawareness of data processing on registration
description: Homeowner may not be fully aware of how their data and device enrollment information will be processed or stored by the Home Hub.

title: Temporary access code serves as identifier
description: The temporary access code entered by the guest is likely unique to that guest, allowing the Home Hub to identify which guest is unlocking the door and attribute the action to them.
uncertainty_note: Assumes the temporary code is guest-specific rather than a generic shared code; flow description does not explicitly confirm uniqueness.

title: Guest unaware of access logging or processing
description: The guest entering the code may be unaware that the Home Hub could process, log, or store the access event and code usage details.
uncertainty_note: Flow description provides no details on whether logging or further processing occurs at the hub.

title: Access event attributable to guest
description: By receiving and potentially recording the temporary access code, the Home Hub creates attributable evidence that prevents the guest from denying they unlocked the door at that time.
uncertainty_note: Depends on whether the hub stores or logs the code entry; not stated in the flow description.

title: Sensitive sensor event data stored in local log
description: Motion/door/sensor events written to the log are sensitive personal data types (revealing occupancy, movements) that may exceed strict functional needs for a basic event log.

title: Quasi-identifiers in combined sensor events
description: Multiple events in the log can be combined as quasi-identifiers to link activities to a single individual (e.g., patterns of door/motion events).

title: Log creates attributable action evidence
description: Stored events provide data records that can attribute specific actions (e.g., door openings) to individuals, preventing denial.

title: Revealing attributes in uploaded video clips
description: The data flow carries recorded camera clips containing visual attributes such as faces, clothing, and activities that support identification of data subjects in the home environment.

title: Sensitive video data stored in cloud
description: Cloud Video Storage receives and retains highly sensitive personal data in the form of home camera recordings, which may exceed minimal functional requirements for basic storage.

title: Data minimization violation in cloud storage
description: Storing full video clips at the destination may process more personal data than strictly necessary, violating data minimization principles under regulations like GDPR.

title: Data subject unawareness of clip uploads
description: Individuals recorded by the home cameras (data subjects) may be unaware that their personal data in video clips is being uploaded from the Home Hub to cloud storage.

title: Motion alert communication observable
description: An observer of the data flow can detect the real-time motion alert being forwarded, revealing the presence or activity of individuals in the home.

title: Sensitive motion data shared
description: The Home Hub shares a motion alert which can reveal highly sensitive information about occupancy and activity in a private home, and this data type may be more sensitive than strictly required for basic alerting.

title: Data propagated to backend
description: The motion alert data becomes accessible to the mobile app backend service, which may not be strictly necessary if local processing or direct peer-to-peer notification were possible.

title: Linking via flow metadata
description: The communication flow links the specific Home Hub (P1) with the Mobile App Backend (P2), potentially allowing identification or profiling of the user through metadata about the parties involved.
uncertainty_note: Depends on whether the flow uses identifiable metadata such as device IDs or account tokens; not explicitly stated in description.

title: Unique identifier links notification to homeowner
description: The push notification delivery relies on a unique device or user identifier to target the specific homeowner's phone, linking the motion detection event to that individual.

title: Identified information in push metadata
description: Metadata of the notification push (e.g., device tokens, routing info) contains identified information about the homeowner.

title: Observed communications reveal motion events
description: The existence and timing of motion-detected notifications can be observed in the communication flow, detecting activity at the homeowner's property.

title: Notification visible to unintended viewers
description: The motion notification received on the phone may be visible on the lock screen or to others nearby, disclosing personal activity data to more parties than necessary.

title: Analytics shared with predetermined external vendor
description: The mobile app backend shares aggregated device-usage analytics with a cloud analytics vendor, making personal data accessible to an external predetermined party.

title: Data subjects unaware of analytics sharing
description: Users may be unaware that their device-usage data is collected and aggregated for sharing with an external cloud analytics vendor.

title: Propagation to analytics vendor
description: Data propagated to the cloud analytics vendor where further processing may occur beyond the original collection purpose.

title: Video clip reveals identifying attributes
description: The mobile app backend receives a video clip that includes revealing attributes such as the homeowner's property, potential individuals present, and other visual details from which the identity of the data subject can be derived.

title: Disclosure of sensitive video data type
description: The cloud video storage shares highly sensitive video clip data with the backend process, where video footage of a private home environment may be perceived as highly sensitive personal data.

title: Video data as attributable evidence
description: The retrieved video clip data can be used to attribute actions or events to the homeowner or data subjects, preventing denial of claims about what occurred at the property.
